entries.title: Psalms 115:1
segments: ¶Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, [and] for thy truth's sake.

words.text: , not unto us, but unto thy name

entries.title: Psalms 115:2
segments: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where [is] now their God?

entries.title: Psalms 115:3
segments: But our God [is] in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

entries.title: Psalms 115:4
segments: Their idols [are] silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

entries.title: Psalms 115:5
segments: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

entries.title: Psalms 115:6
segments: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

entries.title: Psalms 115:7
segments: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

entries.title: Psalms 115:8
segments: They that make them are like unto them; [so is] every one that trusteth in them.

words.text: them are like unto them; [so is] every one that trusteth

entries.title: Psalms 115:9
segments: ¶O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he [is] their help and their shield.

entries.title: Psalms 115:10
segments: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he [is] their help and their shield.

entries.title: Psalms 115:11
segments: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he [is] their help and their shield.

entries.title: Psalms 115:12
segments: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless [us]; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

entries.title: Psalms 115:13
segments: He will bless them that fear the LORD, [both] small and great. {and: Heb. with}

entries.title: Psalms 115:14
segments: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

words.text: you more and more, you and your children

entries.title: Psalms 115:15
segments: Ye [are] blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.

entries.title: Psalms 115:16
segments: The heaven, [even] the heavens, [are] the LORD'S: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 115:17
segments: The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.

entries.title: Psalms 115:18
segments: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.

words.text: from this time forth and for
